programs.title: Golden Years
programs.desc: Fate, the pensions crisis and a steadfast refusal to accept the injustice of old age have contrived to force law abiding, retired couple, Arthur and Martha Goode into a life of crime. Refusing to take the loss of their pensions lying down and to fade away into their declining years, our characters decide to fight back. They decide to take back what was theirs in the first place. They decide to start robbing banks.

programs.title: Monty Python's Life Of Brian
programs.desc: Brian Cohen is an average young Jewish man, but through a series of ridiculous events, he gains a reputation as the Messiah. When he's not dodging his followers or being scolded by his shrill mother, the hapless Brian has to contend with the pompous Pontius Pilate and acronym-obsessed members of a separatist movement. Rife with Monty Python's signature absurdity, the tale finds Brian's life paralleling Biblical lore, albeit with many more laughs.

programs.title: The Commitments
programs.desc: Jimmy Rabbitte is a would-be music business wheeler and dealer, and he's decided what Dublin needs is a top-shelf soul band. However, top-shelf soul musicians are hard to find in Dublin, so he has to make do with what he can find. Before long, the band, called the Commitments, is packing them in at local clubs. Do they have what it takes to make the big time?

programs.title: Long Story Short
programs.desc: Ellen and her friends all dream of living in the perfect relationship with their one true match—but their real lives are far removed from these romantic ideals. We follow them over three years and eight parties, as they navigate countless complications and each experience their own emotional highs and lows in love.

programs.title: Unfaithful
programs.desc: Connie, a middle-aged wife and mother, has an affair with Paul, a handsome young Frenchman. When Connie's husband, Edward, becomes suspicious, he hires a private investigator. When his fears are confirmed, Edward confronts Paul in a decision that will come to haunt him.

programs.title: The House
programs.desc: 27-year-old French writer Emma immerses herself in Berlin's sex trade to research her novel. What begins as brief research becomes a two-year journey of desire, danger and discovery.
